title: dryopteris thelypteris subsp. pubescens
intro: Dryopteris thelypteris subsp. pubescens, commonly known as a type of shield fern, is a plant species native to certain regions of the world. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and improve respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris thelypteris subsp. pubescens include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can aid in the relief of coughs, bronchitis, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential health benefits.
